game.name: Bullet Witch (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: Bullet Witch is an action-adventure game for Xbox 360. Alicia, the Bullet Witch, is the only one able to save what remains of humanity from a demonic invasion. In 2013, after many humans have already succumbed to cataclysms, hordes of hellish creatures descend on Earth. Alicia, a witch by trade, must face these enemies to ensure the planet's survival.
